note: Production NUL-join: fixture 'aaa bbb ccc dd\0dd' (NUL in the 'dd' overflow). Typing X at End triggers the first wrap, whose spillage target 'd\0ddX' carries a payload NUL. Returning to the predecessor and typing ' eee' triggers an accepted second-wrap join whose assembled current line + spillage target contains the NUL. The production join path (hard_wrap -> decode_nuls -> replace) must preserve the NUL as a payload byte (0x00) in the saved file, not reinterpret it as a line separator. Removing decode_nuls from the production join would corrupt the line structure.
